newsitem.title: USA: FAA requires Boeing 737 yaw/roll procedures.
newsitem.headline: FAA requires Boeing 737 yaw/roll procedures.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration Thursday said it was requiring operators of Boeing 737 airplanes to adopt procedures for crews to maintain control should an uncommanded yaw or roll occur.
The precautionary measure requiring action within 30 days would also be designed to address a condition where flight control was restricted or became jammed, a statement said.

This follows an initiative by the FAA in November mandating checks of the 737 main rudder power control unit following two accident involving the 737, one in Pittsburgh, the other near Colorado Springs, Colo.
